Fully executed Master Clinical Trial Agreement for Protocol PPC-4871-III (CLARION — Clinical Assessment of Response with Longitudinal Investigation in ONcology), a Phase III, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of penterafenib (PPC-4871) in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The MCTA governs the relationship between the Sponsor and the Site Network for the conduct of the CLARION trial across 38 Veridian Network sites located in 14 states. The agreement covers site fees, per-patient payments, investigator grants, network coordination fees, technology and electronic data capture integration costs, and operational costs totaling $80,000,000 across the projected 60-month study duration. The MCTA sets forth the parties' respective obligations relating to regulatory compliance, safety reporting, indemnification, insurance, intellectual property, data ownership, publication rights, and confidentiality.

upper_row_ss: The Protocol Synopsis sets forth the key design parameters, eligibility criteria, dosing schedule, assessment schedule, statistical analysis plan overview, and study schema for the CLARION trial. The Protocol Synopsis is attached to the MCTA as Exhibit A and governs the conduct of the study at all 38 participating Veridian Network sites. The full Protocol (Version 3.0, dated March 15, 2023) is maintained on file with the Sponsor and is available to each site through the Pinnacle Data Solutions electronic trial master file system.

The form of Individual Site Agreement (also referred to as the "Joinder" or "Site Joinder Agreement") is a standardized template agreement to be executed by each Veridian Network site that participates in the CLARION trial. The form incorporates all terms of the MCTA by reference and supplements those terms with site-specific schedules, including: (a) identification of the principal investigator and sub-investigators at such site; (b) the site-specific budget allocation derived from the master budget set forth in Exhibit B; (c) the Institutional Review Board (IRB) of record for such site; (d) site-specific regulatory and compliance information; and (e) the planned enrollment allocation for such site. The executed joinder agreements for the first five representative sites (Sites 001 through 005) are included in Volume IV of this closing binder. Additional joinder agreements will be executed on a rolling basis as sites are activated throughout the enrollment period.
